name: Calendar Write Guard
description: Write-side twin of calendar-read-guard. In the exec tool: blocks `gog calendar create/update` calls that use invented flags (--title/--start/--end/--date/--format) or that create an event without both --start-timezone and --end-timezone, and requires approval before re-creating an event already created or deleted earlier in the same session (the delete->recreate display-artifact spiral). Cron/job runs are left alone.
